site.title: MLIFT — Professional Forklift Manufacturer
site.description: MLIFT delivers world-class forklift solutions — electric, diesel, LPG, heavy-duty, and warehouse equipment. Exporting to 50+ countries with 24/7 support.

home.heroTitle1: Empower a world of material handling
home.heroSub1: Leading manufacturer of electric, diesel, and heavy-duty forklifts. ISO 9001 & CE certified. Exporting to 50+ countries worldwide.
home.heroSub2: From compact warehouse trucks to 45-ton container handlers. Comprehensive after-sales support & spare parts worldwide.
home.heroSub3: Advanced lithium-ion technology, explosion-proof designs, and custom material handling solutions for every industry.
home.vpDesc1: Experience top-tier material handling solutions tailored to your business needs and backed by decades of industry expertise.
home.vpDesc2: Unlock operational efficiency & reliability with MLIFT, your source for cutting-edge material handling solutions.
home.vpDesc3: At MLIFT, we deliver unmatched expertise, innovation and support to enhance your material handling capabilities.
home.aboutTitle: Your Trusted Partner for Powerful Material Handling Solutions
home.aboutP1: JINGJIANG MLIFT MACHINERY CO.,LTD is a professional forklift manufacturer based in Jingjiang, Jiangsu, China. We offer a full range of material handling equipment — from compact electric pallet trucks to 25-ton heavy-duty diesel forklifts.
home.aboutP2: With ISO 9001 and CE certifications, our forklifts meet international quality standards. Every machine undergoes rigorous factory testing before shipment. We serve 50+ countries with comprehensive after-sales support, spare parts, and technical service.
home.productsDesc: From electric warehouse trucks to heavy-duty diesel forklifts — MLIFT covers every material handling need.
home.servicesDesc: Comprehensive support covering the entire lifecycle of your forklift fleet.
home.service1Desc: Operator training programs, safety certification, and on-site instruction to ensure safe and compliant forklift operation.
home.service2Desc: Preventive maintenance schedules, thorough inspections, and fleet health monitoring to maximize uptime.
home.service3Desc: Global distribution network. Spare parts available worldwide. Contact us for dealer inquiries or direct purchase.
home.testimonialsDesc: MLIFT forklifts power operations across 50+ countries. Here's what our customers say.
home.whoWeAreDesc: Driven by innovation, built on quality. MLIFT's commitment to material handling excellence.
home.missionP: Our mission is to provide professional-quality forklift equipment at competitive prices. Every MLIFT forklift is engineered to perform reliably under real-world conditions.
home.visionP: We envision MLIFT as a globally recognized material handling brand — trusted by businesses on every continent. Through continuous engineering improvement and strategic partnerships, we aim to become the preferred choice for forklift solutions worldwide.
home.historyP: JINGJIANG MLIFT MACHINERY CO.,LTD was founded with a clear purpose: to build industrial equipment that meets international quality standards at competitive prices. Our team brings decades of manufacturing experience.
home.partnersDesc: MLIFT takes pride in working with leading organizations and distributors worldwide.
home.blogDesc: Stay up to date with MLIFT product updates, industry insights, and material handling news.
home.dealerP: Interested in becoming an MLIFT dealer or distributor in your region? We are actively expanding our global sales network and looking for qualified partners.
home.ctaP: Tailored material handling solutions for your business. Reach out for a quote, product demo, or dealer inquiry.
